items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: We provide an efficient, hassle-free solution to remove unwanted soil, dirt, and debris from your property, all without you needing to lift a shovel. Whether it’s excess topsoil, construction fill, or contaminated earth, our professional team handles every aspect of the job.

The process begins with a free, no-obligation quote that clearly outlines all costs with complete transparency. Once you approve, our experienced crew arrives at your chosen time to carefully excavate and remove the soil while protecting your property.

Environmental responsibility guides our approach to soil disposal. We don’t simply haul away and dump the material. We carefully sort and recycle clean fill for community projects, properly process contaminated soil at licensed facilities, and minimize landfill waste through sustainable practices.

blocks.text: Schedule Your Soil Removal Today – Save Big Now

c: Removing unwanted soil shouldn’t require heavy equipment rentals or backbreaking labor. Our expert soil removal service starts at just {{cad_125}}, and we handle every step for you. We’ll excavate and haul away dirt, clay, and debris from any area of your property, leaving the space properly graded and ready for your next project.
While our trained crew works efficiently to clear your space, you can relax knowing the job is being done safely and correctly. In just a few hours, you’ll have a clean slate.
Excavating and hauling soil yourself is exhausting work, especially for large or compacted areas. Our professional soil removal service eliminates the heavy lifting when you need it most.

Whether you’re preparing for construction, fixing drainage issues, or simply clearing excess dirt, our same-day service means no waiting. Avoid the risks of improper excavation. Our licensed team removes soil safely and efficiently, with same-day availability for urgent projects.
Why tackle soil removal alone? Our fully insured professionals provide complete solutions:

items: Safe removal of all soil types (topsoil, clay, contaminated earth)
Expert excavation and proper site grading
Responsible disposal with clean fill recycling

items: We expertly remove soil from any area of your property, whether it’s a small garden patch, expansive backyard, or challenging sloped terrain. Our crews take exceptional care to protect your landscaping and hardscaping while efficiently excavating and hauling away unwanted dirt and debris.

items.q: Do you remove all types of soil, including contaminated soil?
a: Yes, we remove all soil types – topsoil, clay, sand, and properly contained contaminated soil (special handling applies). Our teams are equipped for residential and commercial soil removal projects of any scale.

items.q: How much does soil removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125 for basic backyard soil removal. Larger projects receive volume discounts. Get free exact pricing by sharing project details via text/photo, no hidden fees.

items.q: What areas do you serve for soil removal?
a: We cover Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, and the surrounding GTA. Confirm your specific address with us. Same-day soil removal availability varies by location. Call early for the best options.

items.q: Can I schedule same-day soil removal?
a: Absolutely! Same-day/emergency service is available when booked. Weekend soil removal appointments offered at standard rates, no extra charges.
